cohort: 40 full-term vaginally delivered infants born after an uncomplicated pregnancy
finding: Exposure to IAP was associated with an altered pattern of intestinal microbiota establishment during the first 3 months of life, including lower proportions of Actinobacteria and Bacteroidetes and increased proportions of Proteobacteria and Firmicutes.
mod_finding: This study focused on the impact of intrapartum antimicrobial prophylaxis on infants born vaginally and did not compare outcomes to other modes of delivery.
